satirlar.metin: Want a skill people actually pay for? Here are five you can learn online. Let's count down!
Number five: sales. Every business needs someone who can talk to customers, and you can practice it anywhere.
Number four: graphic design. Logos and social posts are a good start, and many free apps let you practice.
Number three: copywriting. Businesses need words that sell, from ads to emails. Write a few samples and show them.
Number two: web development. Small shops need websites, and plenty of free courses can get you started.
And number one: video editing! Short videos are everywhere, and creators often need help cutting them.
Which one would you pick first? Tell us in the comments and subscribe for more!
